---
title: "2-divergent-ranking"
output: html_document
---

```{r}

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(readr)
  library(dplyr)
})

# Helper to resolve a file that may be in CWD or under dara/
resolve_path <- function(fname) {
  if (file.exists(fname)) return(fname)
  p <- file.path("dara", fname)
  if (file.exists(p)) return(p)
  stop(sprintf("File not found: %s", fname))
}

# Load data and rules dataset
data <- read_csv(resolve_path("rj.cat.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
rules_df <- read_csv(resolve_path("dataset.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)

# Use the same attributes used to generate rules
data <- subset(data, select = c(
  "ano","mes","NATUREZA","GESTAO","ZONA","npartos","sem.gest",
  "n.consultas","idade","escolaridade","apgar","cesarea",
  "tmn.geral","tmn.pre","tmn.tar"
))

# Filter to RHS condition (tmn.geral == "alto") for the dataset side
data <- subset(data, tmn.geral == "alto")

# Remove the RHS attribute from the comparison set
rhs_attr <- "tmn.geral"
if (rhs_attr %in% names(data)) data[[rhs_attr]] <- NULL

results <- list()

for (atributo in colnames(data)) {
  # Frequency table in the dataset (restricted to RHS condition)
  t_dataset <- table(data[[atributo]])

  # Frequency table in the rules dataset (count of rules having that value on LHS)
  if (!(atributo %in% colnames(rules_df))) next
  t_rules <- table(rules_df[[atributo]])
  if (length(t_rules) == 0) next

  # Align into a single frame
  df_dataset <- as.data.frame(t_dataset)
  df_rules <- as.data.frame(t_rules)
  names(df_dataset) <- c("value","dataset")
  names(df_rules) <- c("value","rules")
  merged <- merge(df_dataset, df_rules, by = "value", all.x = TRUE)
  merged$rules[is.na(merged$rules)] <- 0

  # Divergence counter c
  merged$c <- 0
  n <- nrow(merged)
  if (n > 1) {
    for (j in 1:(n - 1)) {
      for (k in (j + 1):n) {
        if ((merged$dataset[j] > merged$dataset[k]) && (merged$rules[j] < merged$rules[k])) {
          merged$c[j] <- merged$c[j] - 1
          merged$c[k] <- merged$c[k] + 1
        } else if ((merged$dataset[j] < merged$dataset[k]) && (merged$rules[j] > merged$rules[k])) {
          merged$c[j] <- merged$c[j] + 1
          merged$c[k] <- merged$c[k] - 1
        }
      }
    }
  }

  # Order by c and store
  merged <- merged[order(merged$c), ]
  results[[atributo]] <- merged
  print(sprintf("Processed attribute: %s", atributo))
  print(merged)
}


```
